title: AI / LLM Engineer
description: About the Role The GEOS platform is LLM-powered at its core. Every application uses AI as its reasoning engine — from generating data-driven research and analysis reports, to co-piloting complex workflow sessions, to supporting operational teams in the field. The quality, reliability, and safety of these AI features is not a secondary concern: in several applications, the AI output is acted on directly by operational teams, and in others it informs sensitive care and support decisions. As AI / LLM Engineer, you will be responsible for everything from the LLM integration layer downward: prompt design, output validation, guardrails, structured data extraction, cost management, and the evaluation pipelines that tell us whether the AI is behaving correctly in production. You will work across all 8 applications, partnering with the Senior Engineers who own each application's full-stack delivery. This is a hands-on, production-facing role. You will be building LLM-powered features that go live across six countries on a defined schedule. What You Will Own • Design and maintain the platform-wide LLM integration layer: API client, retry logic, token budgeting, cost tracking, and model fallback handling across Anthropic Claude, Together AI, and OpenAI. • Build the prompt engineering system for all applications — structured prompt templates, dynamic context injection, multi-step chain orchestration, and system prompt management per application domain. • Implement output validation and guardrail pipelines for safety-critical applications — bounded output sets, human-in-the-loop confirmation flows, and audit trails for every AI-generated recommendation. • Build structured data extraction pipelines: converting unstructured LLM outputs (research reports, entity analyses, operational assessments) into validated, schema-conformant structured records. • Design and run LLM evaluation frameworks — offline evals, regression testing when prompts change, and production monitoring for output quality drift. • Manage LLM cost across applications — instrument token usage, surface per-application cost metrics, and optimise prompts for cost-efficiency without quality degradation. • Integrate third-party AI APIs: image analysis APIs for visual data processing workflows, and text-to-speech services for content delivery applications. • Build AI co-pilot features for a complex workflow application — real-time suggestion and guidance, session support, and reflective prompts — with appropriate safety guardrails designed in close collaboration with the functional lead. • Support the multi-section report generation pipeline: source citation propagation, verification logic, and section re-run and diff detection. • Use Claude Code as your primary development environment — including for prompt iteration, eval scripting, and integration code. What We Are Looking For Essential • 3–6 years of software engineering experience with at least 1–2 years focused on LLM / AI integration in production systems. • Hands-on experience with Anthropic Claude, Together AI, or OpenAI APIs in production: prompt design, structured outputs (JSON mode / tool use), streaming, and token management. • Strong Python — all AI integration and evaluation code lives here. • Demonstrated ability to design prompts that produce reliable, structured outputs at production scale — not just in demos. • Experience building guardrail and validation layers for AI outputs — schema validation, confidence thresholds, fallback handling, human-in-the-loop flows. • Understanding of LLM cost economics: how to instrument usage, where costs accumulate, and practical optimisation techniques. • Ability to build and run offline LLM evaluations with rigorous test sets and regression tracking. Strongly Preferred • Experience building agentic or multi-step LLM pipelines (research agents, document generation pipelines, multi-section report generation). • Prior work in safety-critical or high-stakes AI applications — healthcare, legal, social services, financial compliance, or similar domains where AI output errors have real consequences. • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns and vector databases for knowledge-grounded AI features. • Experience integrating non-LLM AI services: image analysis APIs (AWS Rekognition, Azure Face API) or TTS APIs. • Knowledge of data privacy considerations in AI systems — handling PII in prompts, preventing training data leakage, and audit trail design for AI-generated content. • Familiarity with data residency and cross-border compliance concepts as they relate to AI data flows. • React / frontend experience sufficient to contribute to AI co-pilot UX components. The AI Stack You Will Work With Primary LLM Anthropic Claude Additional LLMs Together AI; OpenAI Image analysis Azure Face API / AWS Rekognition (visual data processing workflows) TTS TTS API (content delivery applications) Backend Python — all AI integration code lives here Vector DB To be confirmed — for RAG and knowledge-grounded features Eval tooling Custom eval harness (you build this); open to lightweight frameworks Dev tooling Claude Code (primary co-authoring environment) AI Feature Map Across the Platform To give you a sense of scope — these are the categories of AI features you will build or own across the 8 applications: • Data aggregation and reporting — multi-section report generation from open-source and structured data inputs; entity extraction; source citation verification; diff detection on re-runs. • Workflow co-pilot — real-time guidance and suggestions during live sessions; AI-assisted plan generation; alert and escalation logic; safety guardrails on all AI recommendations. • Field data and operations — predictive analytics pipeline; image analysis API integration; network and pattern inference from structured inputs. • Relationship and engagement management — profile generation from aggregated data; engagement strategy suggestions. • Risk and assessment tools — structured risk scoring from multiple data inputs; AI-assisted intervention and action plan drafting. • Governance and operational dashboards — AI-assisted document drafting, status summarisation, and metric narrative generation. How Success Is Measured • AI features in the two highest-risk applications pass functional lead review with no safety-critical failures at UAT. • LLM cost per application within agreed targets. • Eval regression suite in place before each application goes to UAT; no prompt changes deployed without an eval run. • Zero incidents attributable to unguarded AI output in any production application. • All third-party AI API integrations functional and tested before the relevant application's UAT window opens.

title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer
description: About the Role We're building an AI platform that's moving from a working MVP into secure, enterprise-grade production deployments inside the cloud environments of large enterprise customers. Each customer requires the platform to be deployed inside their own VPC, meet their detailed infrastructure security requirements, and pass a rigorous security review before going live. We're looking for a senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure, deployment, and security side of this work. You'll be designing and building the deployment package, infrastructure-as-code, network and security posture, and observability stack that makes the platform deployable across multiple enterprise customers, starting with AWS and extending to GCP and Azure as the customer base grows. This is hands-on work. You'll be writing Terraform, Helm charts, IAM policies, and security documentation. You'll be sitting alongside the founding engineering team, talking to enterprise security reviewers, and making the architectural decisions that determine whether the platform passes review or doesn't. What You'll Build Cloud-agnostic deployment package. Containerized application (Next.js frontend, FastAPI/LangGraph backend) running on managed Kubernetes, deployable inside any major cloud (AWS first, then GCP, Azure). Helm charts, Docker images, image registries, deployment workflows. Infrastructure as code. Terraform modules that provision the entire stack (networking, compute, database, cache, object storage, secrets, logging) inside a customer's cloud account. Designed to be reusable across customers with minimal per-customer changes. Secure deployment posture. Network isolation with VPC endpoints, encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (SSE-KMS with customer-managed keys), least-privilege IAM with no wildcards, comprehensive CloudTrail audit logging, lifecycle management for data retention and deletion. In-VPC data ingestion pipeline. A pipeline that reads scheduled data drops from a designated S3 bucket inside a customer's VPC, validates the files, and loads them into the application's database. All ingestion happens inside the customer's cloud account. LLM access within the customer network. Routing Claude calls through AWS Bedrock (and Vertex AI / Azure AI Foundry as needed) so all LLM traffic stays inside the customer's cloud network rather than calling external APIs over the public internet. Observability and monitoring. Tracing, monitoring, alerting across the application and infrastructure. Tooling for agent-level observability (LangSmith or equivalent) integrated with the broader observability stack. Security documentation. Architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, security questionnaire responses, runbooks. The documentation that enterprise security reviewers will scrutinize line by line. Customer onboarding playbook. Repeatable patterns and scripts so each new customer deployment takes days of configuration rather than weeks of engineering. What You Should Have Done Before We're not looking for someone learning these skills on this job. We need someone who has done this kind of work before: Production Kubernetes experience on AWS (EKS), ideally also GKE or AKS. You should know how to design, deploy, and troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads in production, not just run minikube locally. Strong Terraform / infrastructure-as-code skills. You've written and maintained substantial Terraform codebases. You know how to structure modules, handle state, manage secrets, and avoid the common pitfalls. Deep AWS knowledge. VPC design, private subnets, VPC endpoints, security groups, IAM (policies, roles, conditions, least-privilege), KMS (customer-managed keys, key policies), S3 (security, lifecycle, encryption), RDS (Postgres preferred), CloudTrail, Secrets Manager, ALB. Experience meeting enterprise security baselines. You've worked through enterprise security reviews before. You understand what "no wildcards in IAM," "VPC endpoint enforcement," "SSE-KMS with customer-managed keys," and "CloudTrail data events" actually mean and how to implement them correctly. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines for containerized applications. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, or similar. Comfort with Linux, Bash, Python. You can debug a failing container, write a deployment script, or hack together a data ingestion job in Python when needed. Nice to have, not required: Experience with BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) deployments for SaaS products Familiarity with LangGraph, LLM observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse), or other AI/ML infrastructure SOC 2 readiness experience (Vanta, Drata, audit prep) — not the current focus but useful context GCP (GKE, Vertex AI) and Azure (AKS, AI Foundry) experience for future customer deployments Prior experience in startups working with enterprise customers, especially in retail, ad-tech, or fintech

description: Software Engineer - II Experience: 3+ years Role type: Backend / Systems / Infrastructure About Aurva Aurva is building agentic security infrastructure for enterprises. Aurva is backed by Nexus Venture Partners and leading angels in the US. We are an early-stage team building deep security infrastructure across data, identity, runtime systems, and AI agents. You will work closely with the founders and engineering leads to understand customer problems, design systems, write production-grade code, debug issues, and ship product. Not as a replacement for engineering judgment, but as leverage for writing, testing, debugging, refactoring, and understanding code faster. You should know how to use AI to increase velocity without shipping poor-quality code. What You’ll Work On Runtime security and observability systems. Identity, credential, and access analysis. Data access monitoring across databases, cloud systems, and applications. Agentic security workflows involving AI agents, services, and non-human identities. Backend systems that process high-volume security telemetry. Policy, detection, and enforcement systems. Performance-critical components in Go, C, C++, Rust, or similar languages. Infrastructure that needs to be reliable, scalable, and secure. Responsibilities Own major product and engineering areas from design to production. Build scalable backend and systems software. Debug complex issues across distributed systems, databases, cloud, networking, and production workloads. Review code and raise engineering standards. Mentor other engineers where needed. Work directly with founders, product, and customer-facing teams. Push back when something does not make sense. Take responsibility for product quality, not just assigned tasks. What We Are Looking For 3+ years of strong software engineering experience. Strong coding ability in Go, C, C++, Rust, or similar languages. Strong fundamentals in operating systems, distributed systems, databases, networking, or security. Ability to work independently in ambiguous environments. High ownership and strong execution. Good system design and debugging skills. Ability to read and improve large codebases quickly. Comfort using AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow. Strong judgment on when to move fast and when to slow down for correctness. Clear communication and willingness to challenge assumptions. Good to Have Experience with eBPF, Linux internals, kernel-level systems, networking, or low-level observability. Experience building security, infrastructure, data, cloud, or developer tools products. Experience with Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure, databases, queues, or high-scale backend systems. Experience in early-stage startups or 0 to 1 product environments. Interest in agentic security, AI security, data security, identity, or access control. Who Will Do Well Here You will do well at Aurva if you: Like owning problems, not just tasks. Can operate without constant direction. Care about shipping fast and shipping right. Use AI tools to move faster, but do not outsource your judgment. Have strong technical taste. Can debug deeply instead of guessing. Want to work close to customers and founders. Want your work to directly shape the product and company. Why Aurva Work on a new and important security category: agentic security. Build deep infrastructure from the early stages. Own meaningful product and architecture decisions. Work directly with experienced founders and a strong engineering team. Solve hard problems across data, identity, runtime systems, and AI agents. Competitive compensation with equity. High ownership, high impact, and fast growth. Perks and Benefits Company equity. Meals, snacks, lunch, and dinner covered. Comfortable office space. Brand-new laptop and technical setup. Direct access to founders and leadership. High-ownership environment with real scope to grow.

title: Founding Applied AI & ML Engineer (Systems & Agents)
description: Our Mission: Shaping the future of Software Interaction Technology is accelerating. Systems are smarter, AI is everywhere... Yet the enterprise software we’re forced to use every day is stuck in the past. There is a fundamental disconnect with the way humans use software. Lots of decision points, pointless automations and agents built to help them and the UI which is impossible to navigate. At Calyb.ai, we are obsessed with closing this gap. We are chasing the "delight" that comes from the moment a user can simply do what they intend to do. We are building an intelligent, non-intrusive layer that understands a user's intent and empowers them to act on it, personally and immediately, on any software platform. To do this, we bring state-of-the-art ML, AI, and reinforcement learning to the table. But we are not just an AI company. We are an engineering company first. We ground every system we build in the bedrock of classic software engineering. First-principles thinking is our core differentiator. We're building robust, scalable, and elegant systems designed for the long haul. The Opportunity: This isn't just another senior engineering role. This is a chance to be a founding member and technical cornerstone of our engineering team. We are hiring for your engineering calibre and systems-level thinking, not for a specific framework. Whether your spike is in building elegant frontend experiences, architecting resilient backend systems, or both, if you love solving hard problems at scale, we want to talk to you. You will be instrumental in shaping the technical DNA of Calyb.ai, making architectural decisions that will define our platform for years to come. This is a heavy engineering role. You won't be writing or reading papers; you’ll be deploying them on production for our customers across the globe. You will work on: Hybrid Architectures: Routing easier tasks to fine-tuned 7B models (Llama/Mistral) and complex reasoning to SOTA frontier models. The "Data Flywheel": Building pipelines that turn user interaction logs into high-quality instruction-tuning datasets. System 2 Thinking: Implementing "Chain of Thought" and self-correction loops that allow agents to recover from errors automatically. What You’ll Do Architect & Build: Design, build, and own core components of the Calyb.ai platform, from our user-facing SDKs to our backend AI orchestration and data processing pipelines. Solve Foundational Problems: Tackle our most complex technical challenges. How do we build a real-time system that can scale to millions of user interactions? How do we design a multi-tenant architecture that is both secure and performant? Drive Technical Excellence: Set the bar for engineering at Calyb.ai. You will champion best practices in software design, code quality, and testing, shaping our engineering culture from day one. Own the Full Lifecycle: Take ambiguous, high-level ideas and own them from a whiteboard sketch through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Lead & Mentor: As a founding team member, you will be a key voice in our product and technical strategy and will help mentor and grow the team. This Role is for You If... You are a First-Principles Thinker: You have an exceptional grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, databases, networking, distributed systems). You are a Systems Architect at Heart: You don't just write code; you design robust, scalable, and maintainable systems. You can instinctively reason about trade-offs between performance, cost, and reliability. You've Built for Scale: You have significant industry experience building and scaling complex, real-world applications. You have battle scars and stories to tell. You are a Versatile Problem-Solver: You might be a backend specialist, a frontend wizard, or a rare true generalist. Your core strength is your ability to pick up any tool, learn any system, and build a world-class solution. You Thrive in Ambiguity: You are a proactive self-starter who doesn't wait for instructions. You see a problem, outline a solution, and get it done. You Have a Bias for Action: You believe that "done" is better than "perfect" and have a proven ability to iterate quickly, test in the real world, and learn from your results.** Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves) Cloud Architecture: Deep expertise in designing, deploying, and managing scalable infrastructure on AWS or GCP. Experience tinkering with Agents: Past building experience and knows in and outs of building and working with AI Agents. How to break these, how to make them work... Database Mastery: Proven experience with large-scale database optimization, query tuning, and sharding strategies for both SQL and NoSQL. AI/ML Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Spark, Airflow) and familiarity with the modern ML stack, including Vector DBs (like Pinecone, Milvus) or model training workflows. Low-Level Performance: A strong understanding of operating systems, networking, and low-level optimization techniques to squeeze maximum performance out of systems. Modern Stack: Prior experience with application stack (e.g., Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript) or similar modern technologies. To be clear: your core engineering principles are far more important to us than any specific technology on this list. Why Join Calyb.ai? Foundational Impact: You will build the core of our product and culture. Your work will matter every single day on production level for our customers. (not PoC or flashy demos) True Ownership: This is a partnership. You will receive significant equity as a founding team member. Complex Challenges: We are solving deeply interesting problems at the intersection of AI, HCI, and large-scale systems. Autonomy: You will have the freedom to make key decisions and the responsibility to see them through. A-Team: Work alongside a small, passionate, and highly skilled team. Growth: This is a chance to grow from an individual contributor to a technical leader as the company scales. How to Apply If you're excited by the challenge of building something truly new from the ground up, we want to hear from you. Please send your resume and a link to your LinkedIn, GitHub, or portfolio. A few lines on the most complex system you've built or a problem you're proud of solving would be fantastic.

This role is highly hands-on and execution-driven, requiring strong technical skills, adaptability, and the ability to quickly understand business workflows and deploy scalable solutions. You will collaborate across teams to implement systems, optimize operations, integrate AI workflows, and solve technical challenges directly tied to product delivery and business impact. Build, customize, and optimize internal tools, automations, APIs, and operational systems. Collaborate with clients or internal stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. Document technical workflows, implementation logic, edge cases, and deployment processes. Continuously improve systems performance, automation reliability, and operational efficiency. Good understanding of APIs, backend systems, and automation workflows. Strong problem-solving and logical thinking abilities. Comfortable working with AI/LLM tools and integrating them into workflows. Ability to quickly understand business problems and build practical technical solutions. Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment. Self-learner mindset with the ability to research and adapt independently. Good communication and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with backend frameworks, automation tools, or scripting workflows. Basic understanding of databases, JSON, APIs, and cloud-based systems. Exposure to AI tools, LLM integrations, or automation platforms. Familiarity with frontend basics such as HTML, CSS, or JavaScript is a plus. Experience with dashboards, monitoring systems, or operational analytics. Exposure to DevOps workflows, deployment systems, or scalable infrastructure is an advantage. About You: You are highly adaptable, technically curious, and enjoy solving real-world operational problems through engineering. You are comfortable working across multiple domains — from APIs and automations to AI workflows and system debugging. You enjoy building fast, learning quickly, and turning unclear requirements into scalable technical solutions. You are execution-focused, detail-oriented, and motivated by creating systems that directly impact business outcomes. Benefits: Hands-on experience working on production-level systems and AI-powered workflows. Exposure to real-world engineering challenges across SaaS products and operational systems. Opportunity to work closely with product, backend, and leadership teams. Mentorship from experienced engineers and technical leaders. Industry-relevant experience in automation, deployment, and scalable system implementation. Potential long-term opportunity based on performance and business requirements. Experience related to Python, backend engineering, automation, or AI integrations is highly encouraged. We develop advanced technology that enhances efficiency, accuracy, and automation in Defence and commercial applications. The ideal candidate will work on image processing, deep learning models, real-time video analytics, and sensor fusion to create innovative solutions for robotics, automation, and Defence applications. Implement deep learning models for image classification, scene understanding, and pattern recognition. Work with OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and other AI frameworks to develop vision-based applications. Optimize inference pipelines for real-time processing on edge devices and embeded systems. Optimize data pipelines for low-latency real-time vision processing. Software Development & Optimization Develop and maintain efficient, production-ready code in Python and C++. Optimize deep learning and computer vision pipelines for edge computing and embedded platforms (NVIDIA Jetson, ARM, FPGA, etc.). Deploy AI models on cloud and on-premise computing architectures. Utilize CUDA, TensorRT, and OpenCL for GPU acceleration. Testing & Validation Conduct performance benchmarking and fine-tuning of AI models for real-world scenarios. Develop automated testing frameworks for model validation. Perform error analysis, hyperparameter tuning, and model retraining to improve accuracy. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with robotics, embedded systems, and software engineering teams. Collaborate with product teams to align computer vision solutions with customer requirements. Contribute to technical documentation, research reports, and patents. Innovation & Continuous Learning Stay updated with state-of-the-art AI research and emerging computer vision trends. Implement new machine learning architectures and research papers into production. Participate in internal R&D initiatives to enhance vision-based solutions. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field. 6-8 years of experience in computer vision, AI, or deep learning. Proficiency in Python, C++, OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch. Strong understanding of image processing techniques and deep learning architectures. Experience working with camera sensors, LiDAR, and embedded vision systems. Knowledge of edge computing and real-time video analytics. Experience with Linux, Docker, and cloud-based AI deployments. Experience of leading a project. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Defence, robotics, or autonomous systems applications. Knowledge of SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) and 3D vision. Familiarity with CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX, or FPGA-based acceleration. Strong mathematical foundation in linear algebra, signal processing, and probabilistic models. Contributions to open-source computer vision projects or research publications.

The results: 95% fewer false alarms, investigations 20x faster, and 10x faster response. The momentum speaks for itself: we doubled new ARR in FY26, and have delivered results for world-class customers including Cisco, ServiceNow, SentinelOne, TikTok, Bayer, and MoMA. That kind of momentum creates an environment where great people thrive, and it shows: we recently ranked #71 out of 500 on the Forbes best startup employers list. Founded in 2017 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, and Allegion Ventures, Ambient.ai is on a fast-paced journey to fulfill our mission: prevent every security incident possible. Ready to learn more? Connect with us on LinkedIn and YouTube About the role: We are bootstrapping our India Technology Engineering division with exponential growth ahead. Working under the leadership of Kiran Palan and Vikesh Khanna, you will contribute majorly to our core platform and security engineering of Ambient.ai, and will help in bootstrapping the India Technology Centre. What you'll do: Design and implement REST and GraphQL endpoints. Design and implement highly available, latency-sensitive, fault-tolerant microservices. Core infrastructure for processing large volumes of video streaming data. Improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of all backend services. Develop large-scale platform problems and own small-to-medium platform features end-to-end. You will work as an important member of the platform team that owns one or more services/product features, end-to-end. Expect to be challenged and stretch your skills regularly. What you'll bring: BS in Computer Science or equivalent field with a programming background. At least 4+ years of experience building scalable and available web services. Strong experience working with at least one of the object-oriented programming languages, such as Python, Django, and React.js, would be required. Expertise in APIs (REST / GraphQL), general web backend design principles, relational databases (MySQL / Postgres), streaming pipelines, pub-sub systems, and indexing systems. Write clean and maintainable code. Design and implement complex systems, including communication between several services (pub-sub paradigm, microservices architecture). Manage service reliability, including any cloud operations work (AWS, Google Cloud). Experience with Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar tools/technologies will be highly preferred. Experience building SaaS product offerings will be a huge advantage. Why join us: We are creating an entirely new category within a 120+ billion-dollar physical security industry and looking for team members who are also passionate about our mission to prevent every security incident possible We have an impressive customer roster of F500 companies, including Adobe, SentinelOne, and TikTok Regular Full-time employees receive stock options for the opportunity to share ownership in the success of our company Comprehensive health + welfare package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, EAP, Legal Services, 401k plan) We offer flexible time off to rest and recharge, including Winter Break (time off between Christmas and New Year’s for most roles, depending on customer demand) You’ll receive everything you need to hit the ground running, including cutting-edge equipment and branded gear Enjoy a full range of opportunities to connect with your awesome co-workers We love tohike, are foodies, and love music! title: Technical Lead - Internal Applications
description: About the Role We are hiring a Tech Lead to build and lead the team responsible for custom internal applications and workflow automation across Finance, HR, Operations and other business functions. The team uses AI-assisted development and automation tools such as Claude, Copilot and similar technologies to improve development velocity and quality. This is a technically hands-on leadership role, but not a day-to-day coding position. You will contribute to critical prototypes and foundational components when required, while primarily owning architecture decisions, code reviews, technical standards and complex production issues. Technical Expectations: Strong software design and system-design fundamentals Database and data-modelling experience Third-party integrations Code review and engineering-quality ownership Experience operating production applications Full-stack development depth Experience: 6+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a Tech Lead, Lead Engineer or equivalent technical leadership role. What You Will Do Build Internal Business Applications Design and develop internal applications for business teams. Build internal platforms and workflow systems that streamline business operations across functions. Create configurable approval workflows, task management systems, and process automation solutions to improve efficiency, governance, and scalability. Develop dashboards, reporting systems, and operational tools. Automate Business Processes Identify manual processes and automate them through software. Build workflow engines, integrations, and automation solutions. Leverage AI and modern automation technologies to improve productivity. Own End-to-End Delivery Design system architecture and technical solutions. Develop, test, deploy, and maintain Internal applications. Continuously improve systems based on feedback and business needs. Integrate Systems Build integrations between HRMS, Finance, CRM, and other internal systems. Ensure data flows seamlessly across platforms. Improve reporting, visibility, and operational efficiency. Examples of Problems You May Solve Automating employee onboarding and offboarding workflows. Building employee self-service portals. Automating approval workflows and business processes in Finance. Developing internal productivity and operations tools. Creating Finance and HR reporting systems. Building AI-powered workflows and automation solutions. Integrating multiple business applications into a unified platform. Eliminating repetitive manual work through technology. What We Are Looking For 4+ years of software engineering experience. Strong coding skills and software design fundamentals. Experience building web applications, enterprise applications, workflow systems, automation platforms, or internal tools. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into software solutions. Strong ownership and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Experience in workflow automation, enterprise application development, digital transformation, or business process automation. Experience working with AI-enabled automation tools and modern development frameworks. Prior experience leading small engineering teams.

title: AI Workflow Automation Engineer
description: About the role Ayatix Labs builds AI-powered automation systems for clients across industries. No two engagements look the same: lead generation, content pipelines, internal ops automation, and whatever a client needs built next. We want an engineer who can take a project from process discovery to a live, maintained system largely on their own. This is a hands-on builder role, not an advisory one. What you will do • Turn a client's messy manual process into a clean automated workflow. • Scope, build, test, and ship solutions end to end, in whatever domain the project sits. • Default to no-code or low-code, and drop into code when it hits a limit. • Integrate LLMs into workflows: content generation, extraction, chat agents, multi-step reasoning. • Wire systems together via APIs and webhooks: CRMs, CMSs, databases, scraping tools, messaging. • Build lightweight interfaces when needed: dashboards, internal tools, simple apps, chat widgets. • Build for reliability and handover, so systems keep running without you. Core skills • Orchestration (primary): production-level Make.com (routers, error handlers, data stores); exposure to n8n, Zapier, or Zoho Flow; knows when an automation has outgrown no-code. • Scripting: writes Python for the gaps no-code cannot fill (logic, data wrangling, API calls, parsing). Not a full software engineer, but not blocked when a problem needs code. • AI orchestration: strong prompt engineering for structured output; chains LLM calls and understands agent basics; builds RAG (chunking, embeddings, retrieval, guardrails); direct API integration with Claude, OpenAI, or equivalents; cost-aware on tokens and model choice. • Integration and APIs: REST, auth (OAuth, keys, tokens), webhooks, pagination, idempotency; integrates CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Salesforce), CMSs, databases, spreadsheets. • Interfaces (functional, not pixel-perfect): builds usable dashboards and tools with no-code builders (Retool, Airtable, Softr, Glide, Bubble) or AI-assisted tools (v0, Lovable, Bolt, Cursor); light Streamlit, Gradio, or basic React when needed. • Data handling: scraping from JS-heavy, rate-limited, messy sources; dedup and cleaning; basic compliance awareness (GDPR, UAE PDPL). • Delivery: runs a client conversation, scopes a requirement, documents, and works self-directed. Nice to have • Make.com, HubSpot, or Zoho certifications. • Design or product-grade UX skills beyond functional interfaces. • A portfolio of shipped automations.

title: Software Test Engineer — Manual (Web App) Testing
description: About Us: MCS is a bootstrapped, fully remote IT services company of 60+ people, serving clients globally across 30+ countries. We build custom software solutions - web and mobile applications, AI solutions and digital products for businesses across retail, fintech, education, healthcare, travel and more. As we scale our delivery function, we're looking for a Manual Software Tester who takes quality seriously and can be a reliable last line of defence before our products reach clients. About The Role: This is a full-time remote role for a Manual Software Tester specialising in Web App Testing with 2–4 years of experience. This is not a passive or box-ticking role. You'll work closely with developers and project managers across multiple client projects, and your attention to detail will directly impact the quality of software shipped to clients in 30+ countries. For more details: https://www.mayuraconsultancy.com/careers/test-engineer-opening-mcs?r=rjo What You'll Do: Design, write, and execute detailed test cases for web applications across functional and regression testing Identify, document, and track bugs through their full lifecycle using Jira or Trello Perform root cause analysis on defects and communicate findings clearly to developers and project managers Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and ensure testable acceptance criteria are defined Validate bug fixes and conduct retesting to confirm resolution Contribute to improving QA processes, test coverage, and documentation standards Ensure software quality standards are met before every release You Bring: 2–4 years of hands-on experience in manual software testing, specifically web application testing Expertise in test case creation, test execution and defect lifecycle management Experience with Jira or Trello for bug tracking and project management Strong debugging skills and ability to perform root cause analysis Solid understanding of software testing methodologies and quality assurance principles Excellent analytical skills and sharp attention to detail Ability to work independently and manage your own workload in a fully remote environment Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field Primary focus is Web Application testing. Experience in Mobile App Testing (Android/iOS) as a Plus. Relevant certifications in software testing (ISTQB or equivalent) are a plus What Success Looks Like In This Role: You pick up new projects fast — a new codebase, a new client, a new tech stack doesn't slow you down Your defect reports are detailed, well-structured, and actionable from day one — developers know exactly what to fix and where You catch bugs before they reach the client, consistently — your testing is thorough, not surface-level You switch contexts well — moving between client projects without letting quality slip You proactively flag gaps in test coverage or unclear requirements rather than waiting to be told You collaborate well with developers and project managers — a genuine quality partner, not just a gatekeeper Clients ship cleaner products because you were on the team Complete your application through the website here: https://www.mayuraconsultancy.com/careers/test-engineer-opening-mcs?r=rjo *Hiring Process: * Recruiter screen → 2 Technical/Practical Rounds → HR round (compensation + joining). Onboarding within 10 days. All the best!

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Company Name: RNT Health Insights Private Limited Position Details: On-site from our office in Chandigarh (Rajiv Gandhi Chandigarh Technology Park) About Us At RNT Health Insights, we are building AI-powered clinical intelligence for the next generation of endoscopy. Our real-time decision-support technology helps gastroenterologists identify early-stage gastric and esophageal cancers during routine procedures, turning medical imaging into actionable insight at the point of care. The need is urgent. Gastrointestinal cancers account for roughly one in four cancer cases and one in three cancer deaths worldwide, and most patients are diagnosed only once symptoms appear, often at advanced stages. Yet when these cancers are caught early, five-year survival can rise from around 20% to as high as 90%. We exist to close that gap. Our work has earned the trust of regulators and the wider med-tech ecosystem. We hold two U.S. FDA Breakthrough Device Designations (for our early gastric and esophageal cancer detection tools), are ISO 13485:2016 certified by BSI, and have been granted a CDSCO test license in India. We are proud to be incubated and supported by leading programs including Pfizer INDovation, Social Alpha, WTFund, NVIDIA Inception, MedTech Innovator, IIT Kanpur SIIC, and PGIMER, among others. We are a multidisciplinary team of engineers, clinicians, and regulatory experts passionate about pushing the boundaries of med-tech, united by a single mission: to deliver life-saving insights in real time. Role Overview As a Senior Computer Vision Engineer, you will help lead the research, design, and deployment of the spatiotemporal algorithms at the heart of our diagnostic platform for upper gastrointestinal endoscopy. You will set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and own your areas of the system end to end, from research through to reliable performance in clinical settings. You will collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of AI researchers, gastroenterologists, software engineers, and regulatory experts to advance both the accuracy and the real-time responsiveness of our technology, and to help shape how we build as we grow. What You'll Do As a senior member of the team, you will own your areas end to end and help guide and mentor others, taking work from research direction through to deployment. Algorithm & Model Development Lead the research, prototyping, and development of spatial and spatiotemporal models for lesion detection and tracking. Set the direction for model architecture and preprocessing strategy, establishing approaches and standards the team can build on. Integration & Deployment Own the path from trained models to reliable, low-latency deployment on our clinical platform. Partner with software engineers to bring research-grade models into a robust production pipeline, and help define the practices that keep deployments dependable and maintainable. Performance Benchmarking & Optimization Benchmark model performance for accuracy, speed, and robustness against clinical data. Drive optimization so that models meet the demands of real-time use in resource-constrained clinical environments. Regulatory Compliance & Collaboration Work alongside our regulatory and QA teams to align algorithm development and validation with FDA and ISO 13485 standards. Lead and participate in design reviews and risk assessments, and contribute to the technical documentation that supports audits. What We're Looking For Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a focus on AI or computer vision. Substantial, hands-on experience designing, building, and shipping computer-vision and deep-learning systems, including taking models from research into production. Solid command of computer-vision fundamentals (image processing, feature extraction, neural architectures) and strong proficiency with modern deep-learning frameworks. Proven experience designing and optimizing real-time inference pipelines. Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading projects or teams, and setting the standards others work to. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders around a shared direction. An ownership mindset and the comfort with ambiguity needed to thrive in a fast-paced startup. Nice to Have Experience with medical imaging or regulated software (FDA, CDSCO, ISO 13485). Familiarity with real-time or low-latency video systems and edge deployment. Experience helping grow a team, function, or hiring pipeline. Why You'll Love Working with Us Competitive compensation (we aim to match or exceed industry standards). Ship work that directly improves early cancer detection and saves lives. Real ownership: shape the technical direction of a breakthrough-designated product, not just a single feature. Work alongside leading clinicians and AI researchers in a fast-paced startup. Gain hands-on experience at the frontier of AI and medical-device technology. Flexible work hours and a supportive, mission-driven culture. If you are passionate about leading meaningful work at the intersection of AI and healthcare, we would love to hear from you.

title: Data Ops Engineer
description: Experience: 1–2 years • Location: Bangalore (hybrid) • Type: Full‑time Scribie is an AI-powered, Human Verified audio and video transcription service, trusted globally since 2008. We specialize in delivering accurate and reliable transcription solutions by blending advanced AI technology with human expertise. Headquartered in the US, we operate with a hybrid model in our Bangalore office, combining the flexibility of remote work with the collaboration of in-person engagement. This approach offers our team both autonomy and growth opportunities in a dynamic and supportive environment. Role Overview As our Data Ops Engineer, you’ll Manage and version high-quality datasets used for training and evaluating speech/AI models. Build and maintain lightweight ETL pipelines and scripts for data ingestion, processing, and automation. Ensure data quality through validation checks, consistency reviews, and monitoring. Run recurring benchmarks and maintain simple dashboards/reports to track model and data performance. Collaborate with product, ML, and engineering teams to support new data needs and improve workflows. Required Skills 1–2 years in a data engineering/ops, ML ops‑adjacent, or analytics engineering role Python (Pandas/NumPy), Git, and Linux comfort for day‑to‑day scripting SQL fundamentals for joins/filters/aggregates Proven attention to detail (you notice when 2% of files go missing or WER shifts by 0.3%) Nice to have Worked with ASR/NLP data (transcripts, captions, subtitles) Familiarity with S3/object storage and experiment tracking (W&B/MLflow) Exposure to ASR/diarization tools (e.g., WhisperX, AssemblyAI, pyannote) Basics of SFT/RLHF concepts and evaluation metrics (WER/CER/DER) Tooling you’ll touch Python + Pandas/NumPy, CLI scripts Git, Linux, simple packaging/virtualenvs SQL, S3/object storage (Optional) W&B/MLflow, Prefect/Airflow; ASR/diarization libs Why this role is interesting High leverage: Your work directly speeds up research and improves product quality. Broad exposure: Audio, text, diarization, evaluation, and RL datasets—without needing to be a full‑time modeler. Growth path: Data Ops → ML Engineering as you pick up more modeling/eval depth. Work style Hybrid, Bangalore: on-site 2–3 days/week for tight loops with research & product. Pragmatic, script‑first workflows with strong docs and versioning. Small team, high ownership, quick decisions. How to apply Send your resume/LinkedIn and (if you have them) links to GitHub/Kaggle/notebooks where you’ve cleaned or evaluated real data. Optional mini‑signal: share a brief note on a data quality check you’ve used before that caught a subtle bug. Interview process Intro call (30 min) Practical take‑home (2–3 hrs) Onsite/virtual deep dive (60–90 min)

title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
description: We need an engineer capable of deploying AI workloads on resource-constrained edge devices, while also building and optimizing embedded systems and firmware. You will be working on the "brain" of defense systems—spanning low-level hardware control to high-level autonomy—for real-world defense scenarios. Key Responsibilities: Edge AI Deployment: Optimize and deploy computer vision models on embedded platforms like NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, and similar edge devices. Embedded Systems Development: Develop and maintain firmware for microcontrollers and embedded platforms, ensuring reliable real-time performance and hardware integration. Pipeline Development: Build low-latency video and ML pipelines using GStreamer, OpenCV, and hardware-accelerated decoding. Autonomy Algorithms: Develop logic for autonomous operations and robotics integration (ROS/ROS2). Application Development: Create C++/Python-based tools for internal workflows; fork, modify, and extend existing open-source software. System Optimization: Maximize performance under thermal and power constraints using quantization, pruning, multi-threading, and hardware-aware optimizations.

title: Principal Engineer - Backend
description: What you'll own Architectural direction for the backend platform. API contract governance, service boundary design, data architecture, scaling and reliability strategy. Your decisions outlive your tenure. Canonical engineering standards. Author the system design principles, code review norms, testing standards, deployment guidelines, and post-mortem culture that the team operates within. Multi-quarter cross-team architectural initiatives that span 2+ services and 2+ engineers. You define the scope, sequence the work, and follow through to production and post-launch outcomes. System stewardship at scale. Identify refactor candidates, drive debt management, set the modernisation roadmap. When a system in your stewardship area breaks, you drive the response from incident through post-mortem through prevention. Mentoring across the engineering ladder, from junior through Staff. You own the technical growth trajectory of backend engineers. Their progression is traceable to your guidance. Hands-on craft on the hardest problems. You still ship code at exemplary craft level. Code reviews set the discipline's craft ceiling. Hiring contribution for senior engineering. You shape the technical interview rubric and contribute to senior-level hiring decisions. Peer-level partnership with VP Engineering and the founding team on platform strategy, hiring rubric, quarterly OKRs, and fundraising-relevant technical narrative. What this role will not do Manage backend engineers as direct reports. That is the Engineering Manager scope. The Principal IC and Engineering Manager are deliberate forks in the engineering career ladder; this role is the IC fork. Set company-wide product strategy. That is CEO, founder, and Head of Product scope. Replace the VP of Engineering on company-level engineering strategy or org design. Own Frontend, Mobile, or DevOps as primary remit. You partner across these; you do not lead them. Requirements What we're looking for Must-haves: 7+ years of professional backend engineering with Principal IC scope already shipped at a previous role B2B enterprise SaaS at scale: Principal-level work on multi-tenant data, permission models, audit-grade workflows, regulated systems. Consumer-only or single-tenant backgrounds do not qualify. Deep distributed systems, API architecture, and PostgreSQL (or comparable RDBMS at scale) expertise A track record of leading multi-quarter cross-team architectural initiatives that shaped engineering for years afterwards Substantive ownership of platform architecture in a previous role: API contract governance, service boundary decisions, data architecture roadmap Multi-grade mentoring outcomes: engineers explicitly cite you as the reason they grew. Names and grade progressions, not vague descriptions. A history of authoring canonical engineering standards, RFCs, ADRs, or strategy documents that became the operating norm of a team or org Comfortable presenting and defending technical strategy to founders, board, and executives as a peer, not a deferential reporter You have thought clearly about the IC vs Engineering Management trajectory and are choosing IC for this role. A later fork to Mgmt remains an open option; what we need is full investment in IC craft work during your time in this role. Permanent hard-nos: Cannot articulate written technical strategy at the system or principle level Architectural authority is positional (tenure, title) rather than earned through documented decisions Has not shipped at this scope in the last 3-4 years (architectural skills atrophy) Strongly preferred: Go or Clojure experience Experience evolving complex existing backends incrementally rather than only greenfield architecture Regulated environment exposure (fintech, life sciences, medical devices, pharma, manufacturing compliance) What excellent looks like in 12 months Your architectural decisions are referenced in design reviews across the team The mid-level backend engineers you mentored advanced to senior Founders and the VP of Engineering consult you on platform strategy as a matter of course The platform's engineering quality and architectural coherence have visibly risen At least two architectural decisions were made differently (and better) because you were involved Backend engineers write better code and design documents than they did before you joined Benefits Why join Unifize Be the technical authority for the backend of a B2B SaaS platform used by regulated manufacturers globally - a domain where correctness, reliability, and traceability matter more than speed alone A board-approved platform rewrite is underway; this role exists because the company recognised that the hardest backend problems need a dedicated, senior technical mind Lead through code quality, architecture, and the standard you set, not through management Own meaningful parts of the platform, not just tickets A team that values engineers who think clearly, write well, and update their views with evidence About Unifize At Unifize, we are revolutionising the way life science and manufacturing companies manage processes and communication to innovate. Our eQMS SaaS platform accelerates product development and process innovation in regulated industries. In a world where changing regulatory environments, market competition, customer demands, and technological advancements are constants, Unifize provides the platform that helps customers move past the constraints that hold progress back. See our extensive case studies and testimonials and our medical device landing page for what we do and the customers we do it for. Four things customers say make Unifize different: No-code process builder Intuitive, chat-based collaboration Low-code automation Embedded AI Why this role exists The board-approved platform rewrite is underway, and the backend needs a single authoritative technical voice to define the standards that the entire backend team will operate within for the next several years. The Engineering Manager search is running in parallel; the EM role explicitly relies on having a Principal Engineer to lean on for architecture decisions. Without this role, the EM either makes architectural calls alone (risky) or escalates every technical decision to the VP of Engineering (not scalable). We are deliberately hiring this as a Principal IC, not an Engineering Manager. We want the strongest backend technical mind we can find, whose full-time job is making the platform better and raising the bar for everyone else through code, architecture, and standards. Management of engineers belongs to the EM. Architectural authority belongs to you.

title: Solution Architect
description: About Artikate Studio We're a deep-tech engineering firm that has been building software since 2016. We engineer AI-powered systems for defence institutions, government bodies, national-scale enterprises, and D2C brands — from a single AI module to entire mission-critical platforms. About the role We're hiring a Solution Architect to own the technical backbone of our most ambitious builds. You'll turn a brief into a buildable, secure, procurable system — the architecture, the integration design, the deployment topology, and the trade-offs — across our full range of work: AI/ML systems, defence command-and-control and computer vision, sovereign LLM driven systems, national-scale enterprise platforms, and digital commerce. This is hands-on and client-facing. You'll lead pre-kickoff technical reviews, scope hard problems under real security and integration constraints, and stay accountable for what ships. The people who scope our projects own them — that's you. What you'll architect End-to-end systems across edge, on-premise, air-gapped, and cloud (AWS / GCP) — with the right boundaries between them. Computer vision & object detection — multi-camera, multi-feed detection and inspection systems built for accuracy at scale. Integrated Command Systems — fusing multi-sensor and multi-camera feeds into a single operational picture, with real-time event correlation, alerting, role-based operator consoles, and redundancy / failover / high-availability design. Sovereign LLM & RAG — on-premise deployment of Llama-class models, GGUF quantisation, and RAG pipelines over private data corpora where no commercial cloud API is permitted. Air-gapped / LAN-only / zero-egress deployments and classified or sensitive data handling. National-scale enterprise platforms — high-concurrency systems, database sharding, telemetry/fleet intelligence, ERP and workflow automation, and analytics dashboards. Industrial & manufacturing vision — machine-vision inspection and monitoring, PLC/CNC and ERP integration, and harsh-environment fitment where applicable. MLOps — model registry, monitoring, and retraining pipelines; GPU-cluster architecture for on-prem and air-gapped inference. Security architecture — security-first posture from day one, and the procurement-grade hardware specification / BOM where systems are physical. Leading the pre-kickoff brief, technical survey and scope definition, and translating constraints into a written, shared design before code is written. Must-have experience 4+ years architecting production systems across AI/ML and/or large-scale enterprise platforms — designs that actually shipped. Strong computer vision: object detection and multi-feed systems (PyTorch, YOLO-family) and what survives real deployment. LLM / RAG architecture: Llama-class models, RAG pipelines, LangChain, GGUF, Hugging Face. Cloud architecture on AWS and/or GCP, plus Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker. On-premise, air-gapped, and GPU-cluster deployment experience. MLOps: model lifecycle, monitoring, retraining. A genuine security mindset — air-gapped, zero-egress, and classified/sensitive data handling. Backend fluency (FastAPI / Django / Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis) and the ability to reason across the full stack. Ability to run a client-facing technical scoping session and produce a clear written design and scope. Nice to have Defence / government / command system experience — multi-sensor fusion, real-time situational awareness, HA/failover, and comfort with strict NDAs and classified environments. Industrial / manufacturing systems — machine vision, PLC/CNC integration (OPC-UA, FANUC FOCAS, Modbus), and IATF-governed quality environments. ERP / SAP integration. Eligibility for, or willingness to undergo, security verification. How we work Senior-led delivery — no hand-off to juniors after the pitch. 2-week sprint velocity — working software every fortnight, issues surface early. Defence-grade security baseline — air-gapped and zero-egress are everyday work. Embedded partnership — dedicated teams that treat the client's product as their own. IST-aligned — no timezone friction, reachable during client business hours. Engagement details Location: Gurugram, with travel to client sites as engagements require. Type: Full-time, senior. Start: Immediate.

title: Senior Computer Vision / ML Engineer
description: About Artikate Studio We're a deep-tech engineering firm that has been building software since 2016. We engineer AI-powered systems for defence institutions, government bodies, national-scale enterprises, and D2C brands — from a single AI module to entire mission-critical platforms. We're AWS and GCP Certified Partners, Razorpay Technology Partners, and Red Hat Partners. Our engineers are dedicated, senior-led teams that embed with our clients, ship working software every two weeks, and work to a defence-grade security baseline as standard. This is a hands-on builder role: you'll own models end to end, from data and training through optimization and deployment, working alongside our Solution Architect and platform engineers. If you've shipped computer-vision models that ran reliably in the real world — not just in a notebook — and you care about latency, robustness, and what happens after the model is "done," this is for you. What you'll build Train, fine-tune and evaluate detection, classification and segmentation models (YOLO-family and similar) for production accuracy and robustness. Own data pipelines — collection, annotation workflows and QA, augmentation, and dataset versioning — because model quality starts with data quality. Optimize models for edge and on-prem inference — quantization, ONNX / TensorRT, and latency/throughput tuning on GPU and edge devices. Build real-time, multi-camera / multi-feed inference systems that hold accuracy at scale. Deploy into air-gapped and on-premise environments, and stand up retraining / continuous-learning loops so models improve over time. Write clean, tested, maintainable code and collaborate closely on architecture and integration. Must-have experience 3–7 years building production ML / computer-vision systems — models that actually shipped and ran in the field. Strong Python and PyTorch (TensorFlow a plus). Deep computer vision: object detection, segmentation, and classification (YOLO-family, Detectron, or equivalent), plus OpenCV. Model optimization and deployment: ONNX, TensorRT, quantization, and edge/GPU inference. Hands-on with data and annotation pipelines — labelling workflows, QA, dataset versioning. Solid software-engineering fundamentals: Git, testing, clean code, Docker. Comfortable owning a model end to end, from raw data to a deployed, monitored system. Nice to have Edge AI hardware (NVIDIA Jetson) and GPU-cluster experience. MLOps tooling — model registry, monitoring, retraining pipelines. Air-gapped / on-prem deployment and handling of sensitive or classified data. LLM / RAG exposure (Llama-class, LangChain, Hugging Face) and ASR (Whisper). Industrial / manufacturing machine vision and harsh-environment deployment; awareness of PLC/CNC integration. Cloud (AWS / GCP). How we work Senior-led delivery — no hand-off to juniors after the pitch. 2-week sprint velocity — working software every fortnight. Defence-grade security baseline — air-gapped and zero-egress are everyday work. Embedded partnership — dedicated teams that treat the client's product as their own. IST-aligned — no timezone friction. Engagement details Location: Gurugram, with occasional travel to client sites. Type: Full-time, senior individual contributor. Start: Immediate.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: About the Role ParamAIQ is building an agentic AI platform for Indian lawyers. AI alone does not make a product useful. Good design does. Lawyers work under pressure, handle complex information, and need tools they can trust. Your role will be to design a product that fits the way lawyers research, draft, review, and manage legal matters. You will own the product’s design experience end to end — from research results and document drafting to matter tracking and user workflows. You will work closely with the Product Lead, frontend engineer, and CTO to turn product goals into clear, usable designs. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to shape an early-stage B2B product, not simply improve an existing mature design system. What You Will Own Product Design Design the end-to-end experience for: Research module Draft editor Matter Management dashboard Native intelligence layer Create user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs for all user-facing parts of the product. Simplify complex legal workflows such as research, document review, versioning, and matter tracking. Make the product powerful without making it feel complicated. Design System and Consistency Create and maintain a consistent design language across the product. Build reusable components and patterns for the frontend engineer to implement clearly. Ensure new features and modules feel like part of one connected product. B2B and Multi-Tenant Design Design for different user roles such as partners, associates, and admins. Think through onboarding, permissions, and account-level experiences. Design for organisation-level workflows, not just individual users. Collaboration and Handoff Work with the Product Lead to turn requirements and user needs into design direction. Work closely with the frontend engineer during implementation. Clarify design intent, handle edge cases, and ensure designs are shipped well. Share design input with the CTO on product and technical decisions. User Understanding Understand how lawyers research, draft, review, and manage matters. Use that understanding to guide design decisions. Decide where product complexity should be visible and where it should be hidden. What We Are Looking For 4–5 years of experience as a Product Designer or UI/UX Designer. Experience owning design end to end, from user flows to high-fidelity designs. Experience designing B2B products, preferably complex or workflow-heavy tools. Strong skills in: Interaction design Visual design Information architecture Ability to work directly with engineers during implementation. Comfort working in an early-stage environment with changing priorities. Strongly Preferred Experience in legal-tech, compliance, fintech, or other regulated or trust-sensitive domains. Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS products. Understanding of role-based permissions and account-level experiences. Experience building or maintaining a design system in an early-stage product. Nice to Have Familiarity with AI-native or agentic products. Experience designing for AI-generated content, confidence signals, and human review. Experience with data-heavy or document-heavy interfaces. Exposure to user research or usability testing in a B2B setting.

title: ML Research Scientist
description: About us We're building an AI research-and-drafting assistant for Indian lawyers, on top of a legal knowledge platform built from primary court sources. The hard part isn't generating text - it's making sure every answer traces to a real source that is still good law. That's the problem this role owns. The role You own how we find the right law and verify it. You'll build and compare the retrieval approaches behind the product - how documents are embedded and searched, how a citation graph is modelled and traversed, and how we check that what the system says is backed by a real source. Every choice is settled on evidence against a legal eval set, not intuition, so you'll work closely with our in-house lawyer for ground truth. This is a hands-on research role on a small team: you run the experiments and make the call. What we're looking for Strong hands-on experience with embeddings and modern retrieval - dense and lexical search, rerankers, and the tradeoffs between them. Work with graph databases and knowledge graphs: modelling entities and relationships, and using graph traversal as part of search. Eval-driven - you reach for an experiment before an opinion, and you can design a benchmark that measures what matters. Comfort where learned models meet symbolic or rule-based checks. You write clearly enough that an engineer can build from your spec. What it takes to join us We are an early-stage startup, and that shapes who does well here: You own problems end to end - from the open question to the experiment to the call the rest of the team builds on. Nobody hands you a spec. You're comfortable without a playbook. Much of this is unsettled, and you'd rather scope the ambiguity than wait for someone else to. You move fast and decide on the evidence you have, then revisit when better evidence shows up You want the range and the say that come with being early, and you're fine with the rough edges that come with it. Nice to have Legal, regulatory, or another high-stakes domain where being wrong has consequences. Familiarity with Indian law or Indian-language NLP. Extraction / NER experience (citations, entities from documents)

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Product API
description: About NyaayOS NyaayOS is an AI-powered legal-tech platform built for the Indian legal ecosystem. We help lawyers research, draft, manage matters, and practise law more efficiently using AI built specifically for Indian legal work. We are an early-stage startup based in Mumbai, combining legal expertise with agentic AI systems, native function calling, ReAct workflows, and our own 7-Gate verification framework. We are not just adding an AI layer on top of existing tools — we are building the core infrastructure for how legal work will be done in India. Joining NyaayOS means becoming part of an early team with high ownership, real product impact, and the opportunity to shape our technology, culture, and long-term direction from the ground up. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will architect and own the product API layer that makes our AI usable for lawyers every day. You will build the systems behind case files, draft versioning, billing, secure login, organisation-level access control, notifications, uploads, and exports. You will work with the frontend engineer and Product Manager to turn legal workflows into clean, scalable, and well-documented APIs for modules like Research, Draft Editor, and Matter Management. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys architecting backend systems, building product features, designing clean APIs, and solving multi-tenant SaaS problem. *What You Will Own * Design and build clean REST and/or GraphQL APIs for matters, drafts, research sessions, saved searches, users, organisations, uploads, and exports. Own secure authentication and access control, including SSO, OTP, Google login, RBAC, audit logs, and organisation-level data isolation. Build billing and subscription workflows, including Razorpay integration, usage tracking, invoicing, failed payments, and plan changes. Create a flexible notification system for email, in-app alerts, and future channels like WhatsApp. Own document workflows such as S3 uploads, PDF exports, virus scanning, retention policies, and secure storage in the AWS Mumbai region. Design and maintain PostgreSQL data models for matters, drafts, users, organisations, billing records, and audit logs. Write clear API documentation and OpenAPI specs with request formats, responses, errors, and examples. Work closely with frontend and product teams to turn legal workflows into reliable, scalable, and easy-to-use APIs. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of backend engineering experience with Python. Strong hands-on experience with FastAPI, Django REST Framework, or Flask. Solid PostgreSQL skills, including schema design, indexing, queries, transactions, and performance tuning. Experience building multi-tenant SaaS products with strong data isolation between organisations. Good understanding of authentication and authorization, including OAuth, OIDC, JWT, sessions, and RBAC. Strong REST and/or GraphQL API design skills, including versioning, pagination, rate limiting, and idempotency. Experience integrating payments or subscriptions using Razorpay, Stripe, or similar platforms. Experience handling billing workflows such as webhooks, retries, refunds, failed payments, and plan changes. Working knowledge of AWS services such as S3, SES, IAM, RDS, and secrets management. Ability to make practical engineering decisions around scalability, security, reliability, cloud cost, and product needs. Strong ownership mindset with the ability to push back on requirements that may create unnecessary technical debt. Nice to Have Experience working in an early-stage or 0-to-1 startup environment. Experience building APIs from launch to early scale. Experience in legal-tech, regtech, e-discovery, fintech, healthtech, govtech, or other regulated domains. Understanding of Indian compliance, DPDPA, data residency, privacy, and security best practices. Experience with document-heavy products, exports, notifications, or workflow systems. Experience with background jobs or async processing using Celery, RQ, or similar tools. Exposure to TypeScript or Node.js. Ability to work closely with frontend engineers on API contracts. Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public speaking experience.

title: AI Product Builder (Product Engineer)
description: About the Role We are looking for a highly driven and adaptable AI Product Builder to serve as a force multiplier and the ultimate execution engine for our fast-paced, high-reward startup. In this role, you will be the driving force behind taking auto-generated prototypes and engineering them into robust, production-ready software. Rapid Iteration: Stay on the bleeding edge of new AI development tools. Take direction, gather feedback, and pivot instantly to iterate on live product features. Who You Are Background: 2-4 years of proven software development experience - in a software services firm, startup, or your own projects. You have a track record of high excellence, hard work, and achievement - in academics, sports, or other pursuits. Nice to Haves Experience building and deploying AI products. Open source contributions are highly valued. A portfolio of side projects or products you have built and shipped independently. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Vercel, etc.) and deployment pipelines. Why Join Us? World-Class Talent: The chance to collaborate with and learn from some of the smartest minds around the globe. High-Reward Environment: This is a fast-paced opportunity where flawless execution is deeply valued. We offer highly competitive compensation for top performers who can keep pace and deliver results. Fast Learning Curve: expect to learn more than in thought possible, in less time than you can imagine. We don’t care about age, experience, gender, or anything else; just your ability, creativity, initiative, and output. You take on as much you want to, and can handle - mentored and supported all the way. Location Flexibility: Work alongside the team in beautiful Goa, or work fully remotely from wherever you are most productive. Cutting-Edge Impact: Opportunity to be at the forefront of AI-driven software development, utilizing proprietary tools that redefine how software is built. Our Culture We operate at the cutting edge of AI-driven development. We value high velocity, pragmatic problem-solving, and flawless execution over bureaucracy and hierarchy.
